metaTitle: Start from a use case — OCI Platform
metaDescription: Describe what you want to do. The platform suggests the datasets, the evaluation tasks and the models that fit, and says what an access request for this use would be told.
heading: Start from a use case
lead: Describe what you want to do. You get the datasets, the evaluation tasks and the models that fit, and what an access request for this use would be told.

q.label: Condition or body site
q.hint: A few words, for example pneumonia, retina, skin lesion.

modality.label: Kind of data
modality.hint: As datasets declare it, for example CT, X-ray, Fundus photography.

irbApproved.label: An ethics committee has approved the project

country.label: Country or region of use
country.hint: A code, for example CH or EU. Finds models trained or approved there.

invalid.title: Check the use case
invalid.body: One of the answers cannot be read:

intro.title: How it works
intro.datasets: Datasets are found from your words and the kind of data, among those you may see.
intro.check: Each one is checked against its terms of use for the kind of use you give: the same check an access request goes through.
intro.tasks: Evaluation tasks are those that measure a model on these datasets.
intro.models: Models are the published cards that match your words or your country.

datasets.heading: Datasets
datasets.count: {count, plural, =0 {None found} one {# dataset} other {# datasets}}
datasets.note: The outcome is what the access check says for this kind of use. “Compatible” is not an approval: the holder decides each request.
datasets.empty: No dataset matches these words and this kind of data. Try fewer words, or leave the kind of data empty.

tasks.heading: Evaluation tasks
tasks.empty: No evaluation task on these datasets or with these words.

models.heading: Models
models.needWords: Give a condition or a country to find models.

keep.title: Keep this use case
keep.body: The address of this page holds your answers. Bookmark it or send it to a colleague; a request for access started from here carries the kind of use and the ethics approval.
